calls.title: Polymarket<>GrowthBook - Experimentation Discussion
calls.summary:
We need to summarize the sales call transcript in 2-3 sentences, focusing on discussed product/features/pain points, key participants and roles, and next steps.

From transcript: Product discussed is GrowthBook, an experimentation platform. Pain points: Polymarket needs custom randomization at market/event level due to spillover effects, not user-level. GrowthBook doesn't support that design-based randomization but can act as analysis layer on top of bespoke randomization. Features: supports CUPED, post-stratification, custom analysis windows, time series, frequent updates, feature flagging. Key participants: Nick Riabov (principal economist, Polymarket), Kai (head of data, Polymarket), Luke Sonnet (head of experimentation, GrowthBook), Jake Heier (likely sales), Cris Dizon (customer success). Next steps: Set up a follow-up call with engineering to discuss feature flag integration with Polymarket's API. Also need to handle randomization themselves and coarsen high-frequency data.

Summary: Polymarket discussed using GrowthBook for experimentation on marketplace policies, requiring custom randomization at the market/event level due to spillover concerns. GrowthBook's head of experimentation Luke Sonnet noted the platform lacks built-in design-based randomization but can serve as an analysis layer for bespoke randomization, offering CUPED, post-stratification, and feature flagging. Next steps include a follow-up call with Polymarket's engineering team to integrate GrowthBook's feature flags with their API.
